Quick technical note for the record: Outlook on Windows often treats forwarded or delegated events by creating a new local copy when the original has certain Organizer or METHOD headers present. The symptom (two join tokens) looks like a UID collision combined with a copied ORGANIZER:mailto: entry.

Workaround we applied: set a deterministic UID, remove X-MS-OLK-AUTOFILL / X-ALT-ORGANIZER headers, and force METHOD:REQUEST on the update so clients replace rather than create a new event. That should stop the duplication across affected Windows clients going forward.

I'll file a short KB entry for the support team so CS can reference the exact caldav/ical header recipe.

— Priyom
